gear.value: +2 greater striking returning dagger, +2 greater striking longsword, greater sturdy shield (Hardness 15, HP 120, BT 60)

trait_description.value: The soldier's melee Strikes with a longsword become infused with the convictions of their duty, and deal an additional 2d6 mental damage against foes they fight while in Svarýr (listed above).

action_description.value: (agile, magical, thrown 10 feet, versatile S) 3d4+16 piercing

The soldier challenges one creature they can see to single combat, attempting to Demoralize that target. This target remains the soldier's foe until it's defeated, it flees, or the encounter ends. The soldier gains a circumstance bonus to damage equal to their number of weapon damage dice against their designated foe but takes an equivalent circumstance penalty to damage against any other creature. If the soldier is defeated by their challenged foe, the shame causes them to lose use of their champion devotion spells for 1 week or until they challenge the same foe again and emerge victorious, whichever comes first.
The soldier Repairs their shield. They can't use this ability if the shield is completely destroyed.

targets.value: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature

description.value:
Your hands become infused with positive energy, healing a living creature or damaging an undead creature with a touch.

If you use lay on hands on a willing living target, you restore 6 Hit Points; if the target is one of your allies, they also gain a +2 status bonus to AC for 1 round. Against an undead target, you deal 1d6 damage and it must attempt a basic Fortitude save; if it fails, it also takes a -2 status penalty to AC for 1 round.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+1): The amount of healing increases by 6, and the damage to an undead target increases by 1d6.

description.value:
Holding your weapon aloft, you fill it with divine energy. On your next Strike with that weapon before the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll and the weapon deals an additional die of damage. If the weapon has a striking rune, this instead increases the number of dice from the striking rune by 1 (to a maximum of 3 extra weapon dice)

If the target weapon leaves your possession, weapon surge immediately ends.

You utter a liberating word of power that frees a creature.

You suppress one of the following conditions of your choice: confused, frightened, grabbed, restrained, or paralyzed. The target isn't affected by the chosen condition, and if you suppress the grabbed or restrained condition, the target automatically breaks free from any grab or restraint affecting it when you Cast the Spell.

If you don't remove the effect that provided the condition, the condition returns after the spell ends. For example, if a spell was making the target confused for 1 minute, word of freedom would let the target act normally for a round, but the confused condition would return afterward.

Trigger: You and at least 1 ally are about to roll initiative.

You stoke the righteous anger within yourself and an ally. You and the target ally each roll a d20 and use the higher result for both your initiative rolls. You each still use your own Perception modifier or other statistic to determine your results.

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.
